description: Agent-behavior spin skeleton — the next layer on top of physics-test's synthetic scene. Watches physics-test's published position/physics_lod_tier per entity (no enumeration, pure subscribe-by-name). If city-roads' real OSM road network is available, pathfinds (Dijkstra) to a real destination and walks the actual route; otherwise falls back to picking a random nearby point. Publishes desired_target, which physics-test's own steering (if running) consumes — this file has no idea whether anything is actually listening.
author: prackoreal
